hooks.command: bash "${CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR}"/.claude/hooks/run-private-paths-guard.sh; s=$?; [ "$s" -eq 0 ] && exit 0; [ "$s" -eq 2 ] && exit 2; if [ "$s" -eq 127 ]; then g=$(git -C "${CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR}" rev-parse --path-format=absolute --git-common-dir 2>/dev/null); w="$g/../.claude/hooks/run-private-paths-guard.sh"; if [ -n "$g" ] && [ -f "$w" ]; then bash "$w"; s=$?; [ "$s" -eq 0 ] && exit 0; [ "$s" -eq 2 ] && exit 2; fi; fi; echo "Refused: the private-paths guard failed or could not be found (exit $s)." >&2; exit 2
